The ratio of spirit and water in two mixtures of 120 litres and 75 litres is 13:7 and 7:8 respectively. Both the mixtures are mixed. Now the ratio of the spirit and water in the new mixture is:
questions.solution_en:
Sprit in 1st mixture = 120 * 13/(13 + 7) = 78 l

Water in 1st mixture = 120 - 78 = 42 l

Sprit in 2nd mixture = 75 * 7/(7 + 8) = 35 l

Water in 2nd mixture = 75 - 35 = 40 l

Hence, the required ratio = (78 + 35)/ (42 + 40) = 113/82

Adding both equations -

3x = 15 => x = 5

Putting the value of x in eqn(2) -

questions.q_en: A man divided ₹5000 among P, Q, R and S such that the ratio of share of P to Q is 4:5 and that of Q to R is 2:3. If the share of Q is ₹375 more than the share of S, then find the share of R.
questions.solution_en:
The ratio of share of P to Q is 4:5 and that of Q to R is 2:3.

P:Q:R = 2*4 : 2*5 : 5*3 = 8:10:15

Let the share of P, Q and R are 8a, 10a and 15a respectively.

Share of S = 5000 - 8a - 10a - 15a = 5000 - 33a

5000 - 33a = 10a - 375

43a = 5375

a = 125

Hence, share of R = 15*125 = ₹1875

questions.q_en: What is the cube root of the product of all positive multiples of 8 less than 45?
questions.solution_en:
a + 5 is an odd number, for even number, a + 5 is added or subtracted from 1, 3, 5 etc.

(a) a + 4 = a + 5 - 1 (even), a + 3 = a + 5 - 2 (odd)

(b) a = a + 5 - 5 (even), a - 1 = a + 5 - 6 (odd)

(c) a + 1 = a + 5 - 4 (odd), a + 2 = a + 5 - 3 (even)

(d) a + 2 = a + 5 - 3 (even), a + 4 = a + 5 - 1 (even)

Hence, option 'd' is correct.

A pipe can fill a tank in 20 minutes and another pipe can fill a tank in 30 minutes. Pipe A is opened for half of the time and pipe A and B are opened for the other half. How long will it take to fill the tank?
questions.solution_en:
"

In 1 min pipe A can fill 1/20 of the tank

In 1 min pipe B can fill 1/30 of the tank

In 1 min pipe A and B together can fill 1/20+1/30=1/12 of the tank

Say pipe A only opened for x mins and pipes A and B together opened for x mins

Then portion of tank filled

= x/20+x/12 = 1

or (3x+5x)/60=1

or 8x/60=1

or 2x=15

So time taken to fill the tank = 2x=15 minutes

"

questions.q_en: A cuboid of size 8 cm X 4 cm X 2 cm is cut into cubes of equal sides of 1 cm side. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original cuboid to the surface areas of all the unit cubes to be formed?
questions.solution_en:
Volume of the cuboid = l * b * h = 8 * 4 * 2 = 64 cm≥

Volume of each cube = 1 * 1 * 1 = 1 cm≥

If n is the number of cubes formed, 64 = n * 1 (Since volume will be equal)

=> Number of small cubes = 64

Surface area of cuboid = 2 (lw + wh + hl) = 2 (8 * 4 + 4 * 2 + 2 * 8) = 2 * (32 + 8 + 16) = 2 * 56 = 112 cm²

Surface area of all cubes = 64 * 6 * 1≥ = 384 cm²

Ratio of surface area of cuboid and all cubes = 112:384 = 7:24

questions.q_en: Aditi and Aman appear for an interview for two vacancies. The probability of Aditi's selection is 3/7 and that of Aman's selection is 7/9. Find the probability that none of them be selected.

questions.q_en: A works alone for 't' days on a job, which he can finish in 24 days. After that B, who can finish in 48 days and C, who can finish in 60 days join him, and all three together take 8 more days to finish. Find the value of 't'.
questions.solution_en:
Let total work be LCM (24, 48, 60) = 240 units.

Efficiency of A = 240/24 = 10 units/day,

Efficiency of B = 240/48 = 5 units/day,

Efficiency of C = 240/60 = 4 units/day.

When B and C join A, their combined efficiency = 10 + 5 + 4 = 19 units/day.

Work done together in 8 days = 19 X 8 = 152 units.

Work done by A alone = 240 - 152 = 88 units.

Time A worked alone (t) = 88 / 10 = 8.8 days.

questions.q_en: During a cyclone, a straight vertical tower broke at some point, causing its top to fall and touch the ground at a distance of 24 meters from its base. The fallen part of the tower forms an angle of 60° with the horizontal ground. Find the original height of the tower before it broke.
questions.solution_en:
Let the length of the fallen part be 'H' m (hypotenuse)

cos 60° = 24/H

1/2 = 24/H

H = 48 m

Let the height of the remaining part be 'X' m

sin 60° = X/H

√3/2 = X/48

X = 24√3 m

Hence, the original height of the tower = 48 + 24√3 m

Anand covers a certain distance in the first lag of 5 hours at the speed of 50 km/h. In the second lag, he increased the speed by 20% due to which he covered 20% extra distance than that of the first lag. He covered the third lag at the average speed of the first two lags and covered 10% extra distance than that of the second lag distance. How much total time (in hours) did he take to complete all three lags?
questions.solution_en:
Total time taken in 1st lag = 5 hours

Total distance covered in 2nd lag = 120% of 250 = 300 km

Speed in 2nd lag = 20% of 50 = 60 km/h

Total time taken in 2nd lag = 300/60 = 5 hours

Total distance covered in 3rd lag = 110% of 300 = 330 km

Speed in 3rd lag = (50 + 60)/2 = 55 km/h

Total time taken in 3rd lag = 330/55 = 6 hours

Total time taken to complete all three lags = 5 + 5 + 6 = 16 hours

questions.q_en: Three red lights on the same road start blinking at the same time and blink repeatedly after every 4, 6 and 8 minutes, respectively. How many times will they blink together in an interval of 3 hours, excluding blinking together at the starting moment?

LCM of 4, 6, 8 = 24 minutes

Interval = 3 hours = 180 minutes

Number of times when the lights blink together = 180/24 = 7.5 => 7 times

questions.q_en: If the ratio of the mode and median of a certain data is 11: 7, then the ratio of its mean and median is:
questions.solution_en:
Let the mode and median be 11a and 7a respectively.

We know that

Mode = 3 x Median - 2 x Mean

11a = 21a - 2 x mean

2 x mean = 10a

Mean = 5a

Required Ratio = 5a: 7a = 5: 7
